lines.t:
A competition in which two teams make their
<c:ffff00>{{medabot|pl}}<c> fight each other. It's called a robot battle,
or {{robattle}} for short.

Besides the 3-on-3 <c:ffff00>{{basic_rules}}<c>, there are various
special rules: <c:ffff00>objects<c> that take part instead of
{{medabot|pl}}, the <c:ffff00>{{survival_robattle}}<c>, which adds more
{{medabot|pl}}, or the <c:ffff00>{{conditional_robattle}}<c>, which fails if
the stated {{condition_rotation}} isn't met.
